subject: Purchase control: vendor onboarding, PO issuance & temporary spend cap
messages:
From: Olivia Martin <olivia.martin@bluepeak.io>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: New vendor setup + PO process questions for BluePeak pilot

Hi Stephanie / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're excited to move the pilot forward. Procurement asked me to confirm a few items so we can get BluePeak set up in your system and have a PO issued: 

- Do you have a vendor onboarding packet (W-9, bank form, vendor setup form) we should complete?
- What is the typical turnaround for issuing a PO after vendor details are submitted?
- We need a temporary spend cap for the 6-week pilot (~$25k) while we validate usage — is that possible?
- There are a couple of line items in the SOW that need price clarifications (consulting hours vs. platform credits). I attached the SOW we used internally.

Attaching: SOW_BluePeak_v1.pdf

Appreciate any quick guidance so we can align with our finance SLA.

Best,
Olivia Martin
Head of Procurement
BluePeak Analytics
olivia.martin@bluepeak.io
[Attachment: SOW_BluePeak_v1.pdf]

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Olivia Martin <olivia.martin@bluepeak.io>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New vendor setup + PO process questions for BluePeak pilot

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for the SOW and the clear list. Short answers below and next steps at the bottom.

1) Vendor onboarding packet: yes — we have a vendor setup form, W-9 template, and bank details form. I attached the PO template and vendor form for your team to fill out.

2) PO turnaround: once the vendor is created in our system and we have a completed W-9 + vendor form, standard is 3–5 business days to issue a PO (sometimes same day if all fields match).

3) Temporary spend cap: we can accept a pilot cap request — finance needs written approval and the signed SOW before we escalate. Karthik (cc'd) will confirm the temporary limit process.

4) Line items: we can update the SOW line items to separate consulting hours from platform credits. Please mark the desired changes in the attached SOW revision and re-send.

Next steps:
- Olivia: return completed vendor form + W-9 + revised SOW (highlight changes).
- Karthik / Finance: confirm temporary cap workflow and any PO prefix details.
- I'll initiate vendor record creation as soon as we have the forms.

Attachments: [BluePeak_PO_template.xlsx]

Thanks — cc'ing Monica for procurement coordination.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
[Attachment: BluePeak_PO_template.xlsx]

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks, attaching the revised SOW with inline changes (see redlined notes). Key ask: remove the standalone 40 consulting hours line and fold the consulting into a single onboarding fee line at $6,000; reduce platform credit unit price from $0.08 to $0.06 for the pilot. Also requesting a temporary spend cap of $25,000 for the pilot window (Jan 20–Feb 28).

I attached: BluePeak_SOW_revA.pdf. Please confirm if the SOW needs a countersigned signature prior to PO issuance or if PO can be issued and then SOW countersigned within 48 hours.

Thanks — Olivia

Olivia / Stephanie —

We can approve a temporary spend cap of $25,000 for the pilot with the following conditions: a signed SOW (counter-signed by both sides) and the completed vendor setup packet uploaded to our vendor portal. Once those are in place, I will raise an expedited PO request.

A few logistics:
- PO numbering: pilot POs use prefix RBWD-2026- and then a sequential four-digit number.
- Payment terms: Net 30 standard; any deviation needs explicit approval.
- If BluePeak needs early activation (billing to start before the formal PO), we require a purchase order request with a finance approver note in the HubSpot deal record (link requested).

Link to HubSpot deal (please add the signed SOW PDF): https://redwood.hubspot.com/deal/12345

Once we have the signed SOW + vendor forms, I'll queue the PO and try to get it out within 24 hours.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Finance 
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Hi Olivia / Contracts team —

Per Karthik's note and the revised SOW we received, we've created the vendor record and issued the PO for the pilot. Details below:

- PO number: RBWD-2026-1092
- Amount: $25,000 (temporary spend cap for pilot window Jan 20–Feb 28)
- Linked SOW: BluePeak_SOW_revA.pdf (we'll attach the PO to the HubSpot deal)

Attachments issued with PO: BluePeak_PO_template.xlsx (populated), RBWD_PO_RBWD-2026-1092.pdf (PO stub).

Action items for BluePeak:
1) Countersign the SOW and upload signed PDF to the HubSpot deal page: https://redwood.hubspot.com/deal/12345
2) Complete and return vendor banking details (bank form) so payments can be set up after invoice submission.
3) If any further line-item pricing changes are required, please highlight them now; any mid-pilot pricing changes will require a PO amendment.

If we don't receive the countersigned SOW within 48 hours, we'll hold the PO in a pending state and will not increase the active spend cap until the paperwork is complete.

Thanks everyone — onboarding is in motion.

Best,
